kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أقتحم (form VIII)
# أَقْتَحِمُ (ʔaqtaḥimu) /ʔaq.ta.ħi.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# أُقْتَحَمُ (ʔuqtaḥamu) /ʔuq.ta.ħa.mu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# أَقْتَحِمَ (ʔaqtaḥima) /ʔaq.ta.ħi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# أُقْتَحَمَ (ʔuqtaḥama) /ʔuq.ta.ħa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
